note: M1A-R3. Signals carry ACTIVATION and REQUIREDNESS. A pending REQUIRED authority contributes to COVERAGE, never to PASS/FAIL — so an ACTIVE output can never silently waive a DECLARED heartbeat requirement. lifecycleState reports what deployed authorities prove; healthCertification reports whether the target contract is verifiable this epoch.

notYetDeployed: logs/hb/*.hb producers for the other seven components

fetcher.healthAuthority: redis_ttl provider IMPLEMENTED (R3): authority is the key's remaining TTL, which proves the producer wrote within (ttlSec - remaining). PENDING because no Redis probe is deployed to the supervisor this epoch — the provider exists, the probe does not.

activator.healthAuthority: signals are BURSTY — session 20260903_0255 produced none for ~35 min, correctly. M2-D-R4: an EMPTY record set is UNKNOWN (not yet observed) for emptyGraceSec=5400 measured from SESSION START, then FAIL. There is no record timestamp to age, so the SESSION is aged instead. Thresholds staleSec/failedSec apply only once at least one record exists.

volatility.healthAuthority: ACTIVE output (S15R7 --log) and ACTIVE heartbeat (M2E-006). session-bound=true / pid-bound=false because the pid file records the WRAPPER (Incident 023) and each one-shot worker is a new process — a pid check could never pass. staleSec 180 = ~6 nominal cycles (measured 30-31s over 24 samples, M2E-003A); startupGraceSec 240 is deliberately more conservative because the steady-state sample does not measure cold start. cycle must be 'complete' and ts must be present, parsable and not future.

heat.healthAuthority: heartbeat ACTIVATED (M2-D, heat only): the producer was deployed from accepted canonical bytes 6f623cca... and proven fresh from the running worker. Freshness authority is mtime; the payload adds PRODUCER IDENTITY, so a touched-but-foreign file, a previous generation's pid, or a different build all FAIL rather than passing on mtime alone. Output remains text_append: mtime plus proof of growth.

monitor.healthAuthority: heartbeat only and REQUIRED. spread_monitor.py has no identified output artifact, so this component cannot be CERTIFIED until its heartbeat is deployed. Stated, not waived.

watchdog.healthAuthority: analysis.log grows only when the watchdog DECIDES something; a healthy quiet supervisor writes nothing. PENDING_MIGRATION until heartbeat exists.

notification_router.healthAuthority: M2 target: heartbeat (window > the 300s loop). The exit log is a DEATH record, not liveness — treating it as output would make a healthy router look silent.

shadow_engine.healthAuthority: Output authority DECLARED but PENDING_MIGRATION (M2E-016). Causal form: the deadline is anchored to requiredWork.ts, never to output age, so a quiet activator cannot age shadow into failure. ALL_REQUIRED across v1+v2 because 2>/dev/null || true lets one engine run while the other is dead. Full fingerprint stability is mandatory: a v2 rewrite was observed changing content while holding exactly 2604110 bytes. ACTIVATION BLOCKED by SHADOW-SILENT-FAILURE.
